disposition.note: Native paints the grey category axis before the turquoise zero-valued series; output paints the grey axis afterward, leaving two teal edges with a grey center. Matched 300 DPI chart-left/right crops show this overlap. The same clusters also contain the independent marker-center displacement tracked in #1577 (native zero markers y329.23003 versus output329.79868). See zero-line-overpaint-proof.json and line-marker-position-comparison.json. Neither defect is fixed by moving the outer frame.

Exact glyph-edge clusters reviewed in the matched title/sidebar/table/footer crops; content and emphasis are preserved. Separate individual centered-cell x shifts are tracked in #1600 (base-table-cell-positions.json), even where their fragmented pixels do not reach this material-cluster floor. A combined trace-line pass is not proof that every cell is aligned.

Four matched G7:G11 fill seam crops: previous-row positive extensions cover subsequent row colors. Sidebar seams at F2/F5 share that overlay order: E2/E5 pale right strips paint after the rose fills, hiding 0.82pt of their left edge. Source styles and native/output paint order verified; see sidebar-junction-paint-order.json.
